meta.title: Recurring Events: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as the non-Buyer user and attempt to schedule a recurring event.
Sign in as a Buyer in the same tenant and repeat the recurring-event scheduling attempt.
Verify whether the tenant's RBAC configuration intentionally grants recurring-event access to roles other than Buyer.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as the non-Buyer user and attempt to schedule a recurring event.; Sign in as a Buyer in the same tenant and repeat the recurring-event scheduling attempt.; Verify whether the tenant's RBAC configuration intentionally grants recurring-event access to roles other than Buyer.

steps.note: Reach the events list where the Recurring Events area is available.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully before inspecting recurring events.
Open the Recurring Events view relevant to the case.
Confirm the recurring-events area is visibly present; this does not assert role-based permission.

args.need: provide the non-Buyer and Buyer user sessions in the same Enterprise tenant, attempt to schedule a recurring event with each, and report whether the non-Buyer is refused or the action is absent while the Buyer can proceed

steps.note: Alternate-role authentication and the recurring scheduling permission comparison are not expressible by the catalog.
Return to a known screen after the tester's role comparison.
Assert that the events list is available after the comparison.
